# BookmarkItem

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Represents a bookmark (outline) item in the PDF document. Bookmarks allow users to click and navigate to specific pages.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`Children`](#children): Child bookmarks (nested outline items).
- [`PageIndex`](#pageindex): The 0-based page index this bookmark navigates to.
- [`Title`](#title): The display title of the bookmark.
